theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_tff_constant_dehomogenization
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (α : ℂ), MvPolynomial.eval₂ Polynomial.C (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else Polynomial.X) A.val = Polynomial.C α → A.val = MvPolynomial.C α * MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Homogeneity restricts nonzero coefficients to exponent vectors totaling n. On those vectors, the exponent of X₁ uniquely determines the monomial, so dehomogenization preserves its corresponding coefficient. Comparing with C α eliminates every positive X₁ exponent and leaves coefficient α at X₀^n. Coefficients outside total degree n vanish on both sides. This also covers n = 0.
